Implementing Models

Practical guide for adding new device models. Follow these patterns for seamless integration with power flow, autodiff, GPU, and reporting.

The Model Interface (4 Parts)

Part 1: Struct Definition

Pattern:

@kwdef mutable struct PQ{Tv} <: AbstractModel
    # Structural fields (concrete types)
    i::Int32           # Bus number (external ID)
    id::String3        # Load identifier
    status::Bool       # In-service flag

    # Numerical fields (type parameter)
    pl::Tv             # Active power
    ql::Tv             # Reactive power
    ip::Tv             # Current component
    iq::Tv             # Current component
    yp::Tv             # Admittance component
    yq::Tv             # Admittance component
end

Rules:

  • Inherit from AbstractModel
  • Use @kwdef mutable struct (keyword constructors, modifiable)
  • Type parameter Tv for numerical fields (enables ForwardDiff.Dual)
  • Concrete types for structural fields (Int32, String3, Bool)
  • Store external IDs, not internal indices
  • Include status field

Why type parameter: Same struct works with Float64 (normal solve) and Dual (Jacobian computation).

Part 2: Model Registration

@register_model PQ

Makes model available to all_models() for system discovery.

Part 3: Connectivity Declaration

# Single-attachment device
const PQ_TERMINALS = (Terminal(:Bus, :i),)

Powerful.get_terminals(::Type{<:PQ}) = PQ_TERMINALS

For multi-terminal devices:

# Branch: two-terminal device
const BRANCH_TERMINALS = (
    Terminal(:Bus, :i),  # From-bus
    Terminal(:Bus, :j)   # To-bus
)

Single source of truth for topology analysis and external parameter retrieval.

Part 4: Metadata Declaration

function model_metadata(::Type{PQ})
    metadata = ModelMetadata(
        name = :PQ,
        vars = PQ_VARS,
        output_vars = PQ_OUTPUT_VARS,
        residuals = PQ_RESIDUALS,
        params = PQ_PARAMS,
        observations = PQ_OBSERVATIONS,
        ratings = PQ_RATINGS,
        ext_params = PQ_EXT_PARAMS,
        status_field = :status,
    )

    # Formulation overrides
    metadata.vars_by_formulation[CurrentInjection] = PQ_VARS_CURRENT
    metadata.residuals_by_formulation[CurrentInjection] = PQ_RESIDUALS_CURRENT

    return metadata
end

Each section:

  • vars - What to allocate in DAE vectors
  • residuals - What equations this model contributes
  • params - Which fields need per-unit conversion
  • ext_params - Dependencies on other models
  • status_field - Which boolean indicates in-service

Variables and Residuals

Variable Declarations

Foreign variables (borrowed from another model):

const PQ_VARS = [
    ModelVar(
        :theta,                # Local name in workspace
        AlgebVar(),            # Address type
        :Bus,                  # Source model that owns this
        :theta,                # Variable name in source model
        :i;                    # Field containing foreign key
        description="Bus voltage phase angle",
        units="rad",
    ),
    ModelVar(
        :v,
        AlgebVar(),
        :Bus,
        :v,
        :i;
        description="Voltage magnitude",
        units="pu",
    ),
]

Owned variables (for dynamic models):

ModelVar(
    :delta,
    StateVar(),      # Differential state (dx/dt)
    nothing,         # Owned by this model
    nothing,
    nothing;
    description="Rotor angle",
    units="rad",
)

Address types:

  • AlgebVar() - Algebraic variable
  • StateVar() - Differential state (dynamic models)

Residual Declarations

Accumulation mode (SharedRes):

const PQ_RESIDUALS = [
    ModelResidual(
        :p,                    # Local residual name
        AlgebRes(),            # Address type
        SharedRes(),           # Accumulation mode (default :add)
        :Bus,                  # Target model
        :p,                    # Residual name in target
        :i,                    # Foreign key to target
        description="Active power injection from load",
    ),
    ModelResidual(
        :q,
        AlgebRes(),
        SharedRes(),           # g[addr] += residual
        :Bus,
        :q,
        :i,
        description="Reactive power injection from load",
    )
]

Setter mode (control equations):

ModelResidual(
    :v_ctrl,
    AlgebRes(),
    SharedRes(:set),           # g[addr] = residual (overwrites)
    :Bus,
    :q,
    :i,
    description="Voltage control (replaces Q balance)",
)

SharedRes modes:

  • SharedRes() or SharedRes(:add) - Accumulate (multiple devices contribute)
  • SharedRes(:set) - Overwrite (control equations)

Multi-Formulation Support

# PowerInjection formulation (default)
const PQ_VARS = [ ... polar variables (theta, v) ... ]
const PQ_RESIDUALS = [ ... power residuals (p, q) ... ]

# CurrentInjection formulation override
const PQ_VARS_CURRENT = [
    ModelVar(:v_r, AlgebVar(), :Bus, :v_r, :i, ...),
    ModelVar(:v_i, AlgebVar(), :Bus, :v_i, :i, ...),
]
const PQ_RESIDUALS_CURRENT = [
    ModelResidual(:i_r, AlgebRes(), SharedRes(), :Bus, :i_r, :i, ...),
    ModelResidual(:i_i, AlgebRes(), SharedRes(), :Bus, :i_i, :i, ...),
]

# Register in metadata
metadata.vars_by_formulation[CurrentInjection] = PQ_VARS_CURRENT
metadata.residuals_by_formulation[CurrentInjection] = PQ_RESIDUALS_CURRENT

Parameters and External References

Parameter Specifications

For per-unit conversion:

const PQ_PARAMS = [
    ModelParam(:pl, PowerNominal, description="Constant power P", units="MW"),
    ModelParam(:ql, PowerNominal, description="Constant power Q", units="MVAR"),
    ModelParam(:ip, PowerNominal, description="Constant current P", units="MW"),
    ModelParam(:iq, PowerNominal, description="Constant current Q", units="MVAR"),
]

During SystemModel construction:

  • Converts fields from physical (MW, kV) to per-unit
  • Stores conversion coefficients
  • Preserves original values (optional)

External Parameter Declarations

Retrieve values from other models:

const PQ_EXT_PARAMS = [
    ExtParam(:basekv, PQ_TERMINALS[1], :basekv, BaseVoltage(), PrePerUnit(),
             required=true, description="Connected bus base voltage"),
    ExtParam(:ide, PQ_TERMINALS[1], :ide, Dimensionless(), PrePerUnit(),
             required=true, description="Bus type (1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Slack)")
]

Retrieval phases:

  • PrePerUnit() - Before per-unit conversion (dimensionless, bases)
  • PostPerUnit() - After conversion (physical quantities in consistent units)

Access in residual calculations:

external.basekv[i]  # Base voltage for i-th load

The Residual Kernel Pattern (REQUIRED)

Three-part pattern for all models:

Part 1: Pure Computational Kernel (CPU)

@inline function pq_residual_kernel!(
    outputs::NamedTuple{(:p, :q)},
    params::NamedTuple{(:pl, :ql, :ip, :iq, :yp, :yq)},
    vars::NamedTuple{(:v,)},
    active::AbstractVector{Bool},
    ::Type{<:Vector}  # CPU dispatch
)
    @inbounds @simd for i in eachindex(outputs.p)
        mask = active[i]  # Branchless masking

        # ZIP load model: P = pl + ip*v + yp*v^2
        v2 = vars.v[i] * vars.v[i]
        p = params.pl[i] + params.ip[i] * vars.v[i] + params.yp[i] * v2
        q = params.ql[i] + params.iq[i] * vars.v[i] + params.yq[i] * v2

        outputs.p[i] = mask * p
        outputs.q[i] = mask * q
    end

    nothing
end

Key points:

  • Pure function (NamedTuples of arrays)
  • Branchless masking: mask * value (not if active[i])
  • @inbounds @simd for vectorization
  • Type parameter ::Type{<:Vector} for CPU dispatch

Part 2: GPU Kernel (Extension)

In ext/PowerfulCUDAExt/models/pq_gpu.jl:

# Device kernel
function pq_residual_cuda_kernel!(p_out, q_out, pl, ql, ip, iq, yp, yq, v, active, n)
    i = threadIdx().x + (blockIdx().x - 1) * blockDim().x
    if i <= n
        mask = active[i] ? one(eltype(p_out)) : zero(eltype(p_out))

        v2 = v[i] * v[i]
        p = pl[i] + ip[i] * v[i] + yp[i] * v2
        q = ql[i] + iq[i] * v[i] + yq[i] * v2

        @inbounds p_out[i] = mask * p
        @inbounds q_out[i] = mask * q
    end
    return nothing
end

# Launcher
@inline function pq_residual_kernel!(
    outputs::NamedTuple{(:p, :q)},
    params::NamedTuple{(:pl, :ql, :ip, :iq, :yp, :yq)},
    vars::NamedTuple{(:v,)},
    active::AbstractVector{Bool},
    ::Type{<:CuArray}  # GPU dispatch
)
    n = length(outputs.p)
    threads = 256
    blocks = cld(n, threads)

    CUDA.@cuda threads=threads blocks=blocks pq_residual_cuda_kernel!(
        outputs.p, outputs.q,
        params.pl, params.ql, params.ip, params.iq, params.yp, params.yq,
        vars.v, active, n
    )
    CUDA.synchronize()
    nothing
end

Key points:

  • Same physics as CPU version
  • Thread indexing instead of loops
  • Type parameter ::Type{<:CuArray} for GPU dispatch

Part 3: Data Adapter (calc_residuals!)

@inline function calc_residuals!(
    ws::ResidualBuffers{T, AT},
    pq::StructArray{<:PQ},
    _external::NamedTuple,
    ::PowerInjection  # Formulation dispatch
) where {T, AT}
    pq_residual_kernel!(
        (p = ws.res_vals.p, q = ws.res_vals.q),      # Outputs from workspace
        (pl = pq.pl, ql = pq.ql, ip = pq.ip, iq = pq.iq,
         yp = pq.yp, yq = pq.yq),                     # Params from model
        (v = ws.var_vals.v,),                         # Variables from workspace
        ws.active_mask,                                # Mask from workspace
        AT                                             # Dispatch type parameter
    )
end

Key points:

  • Extracts arrays from workspace/model
  • Calls kernel with NamedTuples
  • AT enables automatic CPU/GPU dispatch
  • No computation in this layer

For multiple formulations:

# PowerInjection
@inline function calc_residuals!(
    ws::ResidualBuffers{T, AT},
    pq::StructArray{<:PQ},
    _external::NamedTuple,
    ::PowerInjection
) where {T, AT}
    pq_power_kernel!(...)
end

# CurrentInjection
@inline function calc_residuals!(
    ws::ResidualBuffers{T, AT},
    pq::StructArray{<:PQ},
    _external::NamedTuple,
    ::CurrentInjection
) where {T, AT}
    pq_current_kernel!(...)  # Different kernel, different physics
end

Observations and Reporting

Computed outputs (not in DAE vector):

const PQ_OBSERVATIONS = [
    ModelObservation(:p_consumed, ActivePower, units="pu",
                     description="Active power consumed", default_output=true),
    ModelObservation(:q_consumed, ReactivePower, units="pu",
                     description="Reactive power consumed", default_output=true),
]

Implement computation:

function compute_observations(sol::PowerFlowSolution, ::Type{<:PQ}, var::Symbol)
    pq = sol.prob.sys.models.PQ

    # Get voltage magnitudes for all loads
    v_addrs = get_addresses(sol.prob.address_manager, :PQ, :v)
    v_vals = sol.dae.y[v_addrs]

    # Vectorized computation for all instances
    n = length(pq)
    result = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    @inbounds for i in 1:n
        v2 = v_vals[i] * v_vals[i]
        if var == :p_consumed
            result[i] = pq.pl[i] + pq.ip[i] * v_vals[i] + pq.yp[i] * v2
        elseif var == :q_consumed
            result[i] = pq.ql[i] + pq.iq[i] * v_vals[i] + pq.yq[i] * v2
        else
            error("Unknown PQ output variable: $var")
        end
    end

    return result
end

Key points:

  • Compute all instances at once (vectorized)
  • Extract all addresses once (not per instance)
  • Reuse physics from residual calculations

Implementation Checklist

Follow in order:

1. Define Struct

  • [ ] Inherit from AbstractModel
  • [ ] Use @kwdef mutable struct pattern
  • [ ] Type parameter {Tv} for numerical fields
  • [ ] Concrete types for structural fields
  • [ ] Store external IDs (not internal indices)
  • [ ] Include status field

2. Register Model

  • [ ] Add @register_model directive
  • [ ] Export type name

3. Declare Connectivity

  • [ ] Create TERMINALS constant
  • [ ] Implement get_terminals(::Type{<:YourModel})
  • [ ] One Terminal per vertex connection

4. Declare Variables

  • [ ] Create VARS constant
  • [ ] Use AlgebVar or StateVar
  • [ ] Foreign variables reference other models
  • [ ] Owned variables for internal states

5. Declare Residuals

  • [ ] Create RESIDUALS constant
  • [ ] Use SharedRes() for accumulation
  • [ ] Use SharedRes(:set) for control equations
  • [ ] Match residual count to variable count

6. Declare Parameters

  • [ ] Create PARAMS constant
  • [ ] Include fields needing per-unit conversion
  • [ ] Specify appropriate PUType

7. Declare External Parameters

  • [ ] Create EXT_PARAMS constant
  • [ ] Reference TERMINALS for connectivity
  • [ ] Specify PrePerUnit or PostPerUnit
  • [ ] Mark required parameters

8. Declare Observations

  • [ ] Create OBSERVATIONS constant (if needed)
  • [ ] Specify PUType for inverse conversion

9. Implement model_metadata

  • [ ] Return ModelMetadata with all declarations
  • [ ] Register formulation overrides (if multi-formulation)
  • [ ] Set evaluation_pass (if ordering matters)

10. Implement Residual Kernels

  • [ ] Pure computational kernel (CPU) with @simd
  • [ ] GPU kernel in ext/PowerfulCUDAExt (if GPU support)
  • [ ] Data adapter (calc_residuals!)
  • [ ] One adapter per formulation

11. Implement Observations

  • [ ] compute_observations for each observation
  • [ ] Vectorized operations
  • [ ] Reuse physics functions

12. Write Tests

  • [ ] Use @testitem blocks (not @testset)
  • [ ] Test kernel in isolation
  • [ ] Test full residual calculation
  • [ ] Verify masking for inactive devices

Common Patterns

Simple Algebraic Model (PQ Load)

  • Foreign variables only (theta, v from Bus)
  • SharedRes() for power balance
  • Multi-formulation support
  • ZIP load physics

Reference: src/models/pq.jl

Control Model (PV Generator)

  • Foreign variables from Bus
  • SharedRes() for power injection
  • SharedRes(:set) for voltage control
  • Voltage setpoint replaces Q balance

Reference: src/models/pv.jl

Network Element (Branch)

  • Foreign variables from both ends (i and j buses)
  • SharedRes() contributions to both buses
  • Complex admittance parameters
  • Different formulations change expressions

Reference: src/models/branch.jl

Dynamic Model (GENCLS)

  • Owned StateVar variables (rotor angle, speed)
  • Foreign algebraic variables (terminal voltage)
  • Differential residuals with derivatives
  • Initialization from power flow

When to Use Struct Fields vs External Parameters

Use Struct Fields When:

  • Value intrinsic to device (load consumption, generator rating)
  • Value from data file directly
  • Might modify independently (parameter sweeps)
  • Stable across formulations

Use External Parameters When:

  • Value belongs to another model (bus voltage, base kV)
  • Computed from topology (neighbor indices)
  • Depends on global context (system base MVA)
  • Differs between formulations

Example: PQ loads store power consumption (intrinsic) but retrieve bus base voltage (external).

Architecture Integration Points

Address Allocation

AddressManager calls model_metadata during setup. Your declarations control address assignments.

Workspace Creation

SystemBuffers uses metadata to create ResidualBuffers. Buffer sizes from instance counts. Buffer structure from declarations.

Residual Evaluation

evaluate_system_residuals! calls your calc_residuals! in order specified by evaluation_pass.

Automatic Differentiation

ForwardDiff.jl calls residuals with Dual types. Your kernel receives Dual-valued arrays. Derivative tracking automatic (thanks to type parameter).

Per-Unit Conversion

SystemModel constructor queries PARAMS declarations. Applies conversion using bases from terminals/ratings.

Result Extraction

collect_model_table calls compute_observations. PUType specifications enable inverse conversion to physical units.

All integration through metadata queries. Core system never special-cases model types.

Quick Reference

Minimal Model Template

# 1. Struct
@kwdef mutable struct MyModel{Tv} <: AbstractModel
    i::Int32
    status::Bool
    param1::Tv
end

# 2. Registration
@register_model MyModel

# 3. Terminals
const MY_TERMINALS = (Terminal(:Bus, :i),)
Powerful.get_terminals(::Type{<:MyModel}) = MY_TERMINALS

# 4. Variables
const MY_VARS = [
    ModelVar(:v, AlgebVar(), :Bus, :v, :i, ...),
]

# 5. Residuals
const MY_RESIDUALS = [
    ModelResidual(:my_res, AlgebRes(), SharedRes(), :Bus, :p, :i, ...),
]

# 6. Metadata
function model_metadata(::Type{MyModel})
    ModelMetadata(
        name = :MyModel,
        vars = MY_VARS,
        residuals = MY_RESIDUALS,
        params = MY_PARAMS,
        ext_params = MY_EXT_PARAMS,
        status_field = :status,
    )
end

# 7. Kernel
@inline function my_kernel!(outputs, params, vars, active, ::Type{<:Vector})
    @inbounds @simd for i in eachindex(outputs.my_res)
        mask = active[i]
        outputs.my_res[i] = mask * compute_physics(params, vars, i)
    end
    nothing
end

# 8. Adapter
@inline function calc_residuals!(
    ws::ResidualBuffers{T, AT},
    model::StructArray{<:MyModel},
    _external::NamedTuple,
    ::PowerInjection
) where {T, AT}
    my_kernel!(
        (my_res = ws.res_vals.my_res,),
        (param1 = model.param1,),
        (v = ws.var_vals.v,),
        ws.active_mask,
        AT
    )
end

Follow this pattern. System handles the rest automatically.
